body: Natively multimodal model with a 12B parameter decoder and 400M parameter vision encoder, supporting variable image sizes and 128k context length.
plain_description: Pixtral-12B-2409 gives your applications the power to understand both images and text in a single, efficient model. It reads documents, charts, and photos with industry-leading accuracy for its size — matching or beating models three times larger. The bottom line: add vision understanding to your product with a 12B-parameter model under the Apache 2.0 license.
technical_description: Pixtral-12B-2409 is a multimodal transformer model with 12 billion parameters and a 400M parameter vision encoder, supporting 128k-token sequences and variable image sizes. It is distributed as safetensors weights under Apache 2.0 and is optimized for deployment via the vLLM inference engine, which provides an OpenAI-compatible REST API server for production inference. The model also supports local inference through the mistral-inference Python package and CLI.
title: Pixtral-12B-2409
